page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. No marginal notes. Small marks at the foot and along the edges are not printed text.

main_text.p: generis noftri, matrimonium fcilicet conta-minat: pallium matris Domini inquinat, sub quo occultat eft cœleftis partus: delectatio nem vilium & turpium membrorum, deliti-is, quæ in Deo funt, præponit: angelos Dei triftitia afficit: hoftes Dei, id eft, dæmones ex hilarat, quia vident in adulterio hominis & animam, & corpus maculari.
Quarto Iofeph non ebrietati, fed fobrieta-ti ftuduit. Nunquam enim ebrium putabo caftum, inquit Hieronymus. Item alius:

p.i: Et Venus in vinis, ignū in igne furit.

main_text.p: Iofeph igitur non cognouit cum domino fuo quicquam nifi panem, quem ipse comedebat, hoc eft, ficut Rabi Abraham Sephardi exponit, Iofeph nihil ex cibis domini fui cognouit, præter panem ficcum quo vescebatur, & tamen habuit vultum elegantem: sicut & Daniel abftinens à regis cibis, vescebatur leguminibus, & interim erat corpulentior & pulchrior iliis, qui regijs nutriebantur cibis. Vel, ficut alius ex doctioribus Hebræorum explicat: omnia curabat præter cibum domini fui, quod alijs cibis vteretur Iofeph, alijs dominus eius. panis enim pro omni ciborum genere, apud Hebræos frequenter capitur.
Quinto, non folum verbis adulteræ obe-dire recusauit, sed etiam eius cosuetudinem declinauit: tantum abfuit, vt oculos fuos in ipsam conuerterit. In [?] continentiæ enim præparatione

page.notes: Page number read as 116 but the second digit is uncertain; could be 126. "In" at the start of the sentence after "conuerterit." is hard to read and may be "Ia" or "In". "ignū" carries a tilde that is hard to resolve; possibly "ignis" as printed. Printed oddities kept as they stand: "iliis", "regijs", "alijs", "conta-minat". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The small mark at the bottom centre is not printed text and is left out.
